thread:
alice: Quick heads-up: product wants a clear migration path for the v1 -> v2 sunset. Primary asks: 1) an embed-dimension checker CLI, 2) short compat snippets (py + ts), 3) customer-facing 1-paragraph email. I created a draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4891. Who can pick up what?

dan: I can build the CLI for embed checks. Plan: add `ri-embeds check --project <id>` that reports indexes, expected_dim, observed_dim, and flags mismatches. Will include suggestion lines (reindex / pin model).

emma: I'll own the TS and quickstart snippets. Will add a tiny helper that normalizes old requests (`model` -> `model_id`, `prompt` -> `input`) and a try/fallback example. Snippet: `export const normalize = (r:any)=>({ model_id: r.model||r.model_id, input: r.prompt||r.input })`

leo: I'll do the Python examples and a brief client-side rollback guard for 409 + `x-ri-deprecation`. Also will draft a small YAML runtime example for `fallback_models`.

docs-bot: Reminder: PR must include changelog entry, smoke tests for snippets, and an owner label.

dan: CLI quick plan: (1) `ri-embeds list --project` to enumerate indexes, (2) `ri-embeds check --project` to validate dims, (3) `ri-embeds suggest --project` prints commands to re-encode or to pin. Output will be machine-readable JSON plus human summary. Example output:```json
{
  "index": "users-v1-embeds",
  "expected_dim": 1536,
  "observed_dim": 1024,
  "status": "mismatch",
  "recommendation": "reindex with model redwood-embed-1536 or pin fallback to redwood-embed-1024"
}
```

emma: For the TS fallback example I'll include a streaming note: v2 framing changed; show a `try { await client.invokeV2(...) } catch(e) { await fallbackToV1(...) }` pattern. Keep it short so it fits in quickstart.

leo: Python rollback guard:```py
resp = client.invoke(...)
if resp.status_code == 409 or resp.headers.get('x-ri-deprecation'):
    # fallback
    legacy = LegacyClient(token=LEGACY_TOKEN)
    resp = legacy.invoke(...)
```

leo: runtime YAML suggestion:```yaml
fallback_models:
  - redwood-3b-quant
  - redwood-2b-compat
fallback_policy: failover
```

alice: Good. Sam from marketing needs the customer paragraph. Draft suggestion: "In 30 days we will retire the v1 inference API. To avoid disruption, pin your model versions or enable the recommended fallback policy. If you use embeddings, please run our embed checker to detect dimension mismatches; support can help reindex vectors." Does that sound okay?

dan: Sounds fine. I'll wire the CLI to print that exact support blurb when mismatches are found. Also add a `--auto-reencode` flag that will batch re-encode small indexes (with a big warning).

emma: I'll also add a short snippet to the docs showing how to detect mismatches client-side before calls: `const info = await client.modelInfo('redwood-embed-1536'); if (info.dim !== index.dim) alert()`

docs-bot: Note: snippets must have smoke tests. Please add tiny unit tests that exercise the compat helpers.
\leo: Will add tests for the Python compat helpers + a README note in SDKs about `compat.normalize_request`.

alice: Action items and owners: dan -> cli and smoke outputs, emma -> TS snippets + quickstart, leo -> py snippets + runtime YAML + tests, sam -> customer paragraph and send for legal review (sam is in marketing channel), alice -> merge once tests pass. Timeline: aim to have PR updated Tue EOD to give QA a day. Can everyone hit Tue EOD?

emma: Yes :+1:

dan: Yes, CLI basic version tomorrow, tests by Tue EOD.

leo: Yes, will push examples and tests today.

docs-bot: PR 4891 created: add owner labels and draft changelog. Smoke tests queued.

alice: Great. If anyone hits blocking issues (runtime config missing, or the fallback API lands late), flag here and we'll reassign. We'll also add a short support playbook in the PR with triage queries for embed-dim alerts. Thanks all :rocket:
